title: Frontend Foundations
description: Go from zero to building your first web page. Learn how the internet works, master HTML and CSS, and get comfortable with the DOM — the essential trio every frontend developer needs before touching a framework.

steps.note: Start with a bird's-eye view of the entire frontend landscape.
Understand how the internet and browsers actually work.
Learn the structure of every web page.
Style your pages and master layout.
Bring pages to life by manipulating the DOM.

title: JavaScript Mastery
description: Master JavaScript from first principles to advanced async patterns. You'll cover the core language, objects and prototypes, memory internals, and asynchronous programming — everything you need to write confident, modern JavaScript.

steps.note: Build a solid foundation in JS syntax and fundamentals.
Understand objects, the prototype chain, and classes.
Go under the hood with memory, stack, and heap.
Master the event loop, Promises, and async/await.

title: React Developer Track
description: Become a confident React developer. Start with useState and hooks, move through forms and API integration, learn routing for single-page apps, and finish with performance optimization and accessibility best practices.

steps.note: Start with the most essential hook — useState.
Master the full hooks API and common patterns.
Learn to build and validate forms effectively.
Integrate APIs with custom hooks and error handling.
Add routing and navigation to your SPA.
Optimize performance and build accessible apps.

title: Full-Stack Tooling & Deployment
description: Set up a professional development workflow from start to finish. Configure your dev environment, master Git, learn CI/CD pipelines, and deploy your applications to production with confidence.

steps.note: Set up your dev environment from scratch.
Master Git — the version control system every developer uses.
Learn branching strategies and CI/CD with GitHub Actions.
Deploy your app to production with hosting and DNS.

title: Production-Ready Frontend
description: Take your skills to a senior level. Learn frontend architecture and planning, write comprehensive tests, and master authentication and security — the three pillars of production-grade applications.

steps.note: Learn how to plan and architect scalable frontends.
Write tests at every level — unit, integration, and E2E.
Master authentication, JWT, OAuth, and route protection.
